The trailing hedge 'не знаю эт реально или нет' is grounds restating why the check is wanted (uncertainty), not new information, so per 'Grounds stated with an act carry their own act only when they say something new' it does not become a separate question act. Per 'Taking acts apart is not the same as splitting a goal,' the three things asked to be checked (bloat/dynamic loading, prover coverage, general user-facing breakage) are steps toward one result someone could want on its own -- confirmation the modification is safe to ship -- so this is one piece of work, not several: work_items = 1, and the observation does not itself create a second item. Because the modification 'has just been made' (a completed action) and nothing here changes that modification's goal or constraints, this is new verification work rather than a correction to work in flight, so attaches_to_existing_work is false. The work touches product behaviour (nothing must break for the user), architecture/operations (bundle size and platform-conditional dynamic loading are a packaging/build concern), and quality/regressions (verifying no shipped regression and that the safety net -- product-prover -- would have caught it), matching the worked example's own pairing of product behaviour with quality when 'it shipped without a test that would have caught it.'
